mechanism: Triamcinolone causes sodium and fluid retention while torsemide promotes diuresis, leading to opposing effects on electrolyte balance and potential hypokalemia; corticosteroids also increase risk of hypokalemia through renal potassium wasting.
action: Monitor serum potassium and electrolytes regularly; consider potassium supplementation or concurrent potassium-sparing diuretic; assess blood pressure and fluid status closely.
